publisher: Morgan County GA (zoning layer hosted by tgiddens86 on ArcGIS Online)
notes: Personal ArcGIS Online copy titled Zoning of Morgan County, Georgia; no official Morgan County zoning district service was found (county and Madison zoning are PDF only). Layer is parcel-level (REALKEY, PARCEL_N_2, 11,957 features) with the zoning code in Zoning (e.g. AG for unincorporated); per-city codes are in Madison_Zo, Bostwick_Z, Rutledge_Z, Buckhead_Z. Used as last resort; last-resort parcel attributes, not district polygons.
